layman_headline: Market fear is thick and none of these swing candidates are worth the risk right now.
layman_explanation: The overall crypto market is stuck in 'Fear' mode with a score of 27 out of 100, and it's been getting worse over the past week. Bitcoin itself is barely moving while altcoins are getting punished — Bitcoin dominance at 56.5% means money is flowing away from smaller coins. The swing trade candidates on our watchlist are either tiny, obscure tokens that have already surged (BTW up 88%, PUMP up 34%) or tokens that have crashed hard without enough chart data to confirm a bottom (KAITO down 27%, LDO down 19%). None of them have reliable RSI readings, chart analysis, or funding rate data to build a real thesis around.
layman_action: Stay in cash and wait. The market mood is fearful and worsening, and the available trade setups lack the data quality needed to take a confident position. Watch for Fear & Greed to stabilize or improve before hunting for entries.
expert_reasoning: Applying validated rules: Fear & Greed at 27 is just above the 25 threshold where Rule #3 says the outlook is genuinely ambiguous. The worsening trend (yesterday was 25, weekly avg 26.7) suggests we could easily dip below that threshold. Rule #4 requires at least three core data sources working — while we have price data, news, and Fear & Greed, the swing candidates themselves are missing critical technical indicators (RSI available for only 1 of 7, no MACD crosses, no funding rates, empty chart analysis for 6 of 7). BTC dominance at 56.5% creates a hostile environment for alt trades. The one candidate with actual chart data (UB) shows a bullish Three White Soldiers pattern but has already moved +130% in 5 days with a poor risk/reward ratio of 0.49x to nearest levels — chasing after that kind of move in a fear market is how you get caught in a trap. Per signal credibility intelligence, RSI is the most reliable signal (71% win rate), and we only have one RSI reading across all candidates.

High BTC dominance (56.5%) actively suppressing altcoin performance
Glassnode flagging longest Bitcoin capitulation signal since FTX — systemic risk backdrop
watch_list: Fear & Greed Index direction — if it drops below 25, expect further alt weakness per Rule #3 and #7
Bitcoin price action around $63,000-$64,000 support — a breakdown here could drag alts down 10-20%
ADA's +19.1% weekly move — if it consolidates and holds, could present the next swing setup with proper chart data

context_banner: Fearful market with worsening sentiment and no high-conviction swing setups — capital preservation is the priority.
